`lang: es` gives the Spanish strings that Quarto ships, so the author and affiliation headings change on their own.
This document has one author, so the headings are singular: `Autor/a`, `Rol`, and `Afiliación`.

The role heading is not a Quarto string, so this document supplies it as plain metadata.
Quarto's own label overrides work the same way: `author-title`, `affiliation-title`, and `published-title`.

An extra key under `language:` would not work here.
Quarto keeps only the keys it knows, plus `crossref-*-title` and `crossref-*-prefix`.
